qa_pairs.question: What section and page is this wiring diagram from?
qa_pairs.answer: This is from section 6100-2 Body Electrical, specifically the Rear Defogger circuit.

qa_pairs.question: Which two fuses protect the rear defogger circuit?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 6 (30 AMP) for hot in run and Fuse 23 (75 AMP) for hot at all times.

qa_pairs.question: What resistance value is shown for the rear defogger element when it's on?
qa_pairs.answer: 15 OHMS resistance is shown for the rear defogger light circuit.

qa_pairs.question: What color wire connects from the rear defogger element to ground?
qa_pairs.answer: 5 BR/WT (brown/white) wire connects from the rear defogger to ground distribution.

qa_pairs.question: What connector designation is shown at the bottom of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Connectors C103, S306, and G200 are shown at the bottom of the diagram.

qa_pairs.question: What wire gauge is used for the main power feed to the rear defogger?
qa_pairs.answer: 2.5 GN/BU (green/blue) wire feeds power to the rear defogger circuit.

qa_pairs.question: What does the rear defogger light indicator show when the system is operating?
qa_pairs.answer: The rear defogger light shows YELLOW when the system is on, with positions marked for ON and OFF.

qa_pairs.question: What ground points are referenced in this circuit?
qa_pairs.answer: Ground points G300 and G200 are shown, with G200 marked with a star indicating some vehicles may contain an additional splice.

qa_pairs.question: What switch positions are shown for the rear defogger switch?
qa_pairs.answer: The rear defogger switch shows ON and OFF positions, with the switch controlling both the defogger element and indicator light.
